summary: Tested the new isLoadingEdit feature for preventing header propagation during quote edit loading. Found critical bugs: non-lockBancos items (recurring and additional) are NOT preserving their original cantidad_bancos from DB during edit. Manual header propagation after 500ms works correctly.

critical.issue: Sets isDefault: true for ALL items loaded from DB, including auto-linked items. This causes the useEffect to propagate header values to items that should preserve their original DB values.
critical.expected: Only base/default concepts from SETUP_CONCEPTS, RECURRING_BASIC_CONCEPTS, RECURRING_OTHER_CONCEPTS should have isDefault: true
critical.actual: All items loaded via mapService get isDefault: true

critical.issue: Additional items (medios de pago) ALWAYS get header values propagated regardless of isLoadingEdit flag
critical.expected: During edit loading, additional items should preserve their original cantidad_bancos from DB
critical.actual: Additional items with bancos=1 in DB show bancos=3 (header value) in UI

issues: React hydration warning: <tr> cannot be child of <span> - cosmetic issue, does not affect functionality

concepts_verified: Configuración dispositivo (Pinpad o POS) - shows N/A

isLoadingEdit_blocking_propagation.issue: The isLoadingEdit flag exists but does not effectively prevent propagation for all item types
affected_items: recurring_basic items without lockBancos (Biopago Recurrente, TDD/TDC Recurrente, etc.)

manual_header_propagation_after_500ms.description: After 500ms timeout, manual header changes correctly propagate to non-lockBancos items
manual_header_propagation_after_500ms.test_scenario: Changed header Bancos from 3 to 5, all non-lockBancos items updated to 5

discrepancies.item: Biopago Suscripción para Medio de Pago
TDD/TDC Suscripción para Medio de Pago (Banesco)

action_items: Fix mapService function to only set isDefault: true for items that match base concepts
Fix useEffect for additional items to respect isLoadingEdit flag
Alternative approach: Don't use isDefault flag for propagation logic, instead use a different mechanism
critical_code_review_comments: Line 1373: isDefault: true should be conditional based on whether the item matches a SETUP_CONCEPTS, RECURRING_BASIC_CONCEPTS, or RECURRING_OTHER_CONCEPTS entry
Lines 242-253: The comment says 'Estos siempre deben actualizarse' but during edit loading they should NOT be updated
Consider adding a separate flag like 'shouldPropagate' instead of reusing 'isDefault'

success_rate.frontend: 40% - lockBancos N/A works, but cantidad_bancos preservation on edit does NOT work

context_for_next_testing_agent: The isLoadingEdit feature was added but has bugs. The main issues are: 1) mapService sets isDefault:true for ALL items causing unwanted propagation, 2) additional items useEffect doesn't check isLoadingEdit. After fixes, retest with COT-2026-028 to verify DB values are preserved on edit load.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Multiple issues in Quotes.jsx preventing proper DB value preservation during edit

issue_1.problem: Sets isDefault: true unconditionally for all loaded items
issue_1.impact: Non-base items like 'Biopago Recurrente' get treated as base items and have header values propagated to them

issue_2.problem: Does not check isLoadingEdit flag before propagating header values
issue_2.impact: Additional items always get header values even during initial edit loading

rca_of_the_issue.suggested_fix: 1) In mapService, only set isDefault: true if item name matches base concepts. 2) Add isLoadingEdit check to additional items propagation logic.
